change: Precision arrow joystick with slower repeat and fixed overlay alignment
behavior: Immediate single-step steering remains; repeat now waits 500ms then sends every 160ms. The overlay provider always centers on the actual button and disables platform window clipping/repositioning. Keyboard-visible mode uses 88dp; hidden mode uses a 52dp ring with proportionate internals. Input uses the same drawn button center as the overlay; off-center presses remain neutral until deliberate movement crosses touch slop. Neutral pause, direction hysteresis, original pane target, release/cancel guards, Shift repeats, gesture capture and accessibility actions remain.
